verdict.rationale: Brave Search API offers AI-oriented endpoints: the Answers API, with AI-generated answers and an iterative deep-research mode, plus LLM Context for agents. These are developer building blocks for constructing assistants in your own apps, not a built-in AI assistant inside the product that a user can delegate tasks to. Nothing in the pack documents an assistant in the dashboard, docs or playground, so this adjacent evidence earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
